purpose: Non-executing preregistration drafts for EXP-036–040; no research run authorization

experiments.name: Causal SNR and overnight/premarket range segmentation
experiments.objective: Describe relationships of pre-entry SNR, overnight range and PMH–PML range with trade outcomes without applying a new selection rule.
experiments.control: PENDING: comparable accepted-path ledgers and frozen as-of inputs
experiments.design: Compute as-of segment labels and audit availability, missingness and subgroup counts; avoid post-entry full-session range features.
dependencies: EXP-035 causal-regime design or independent justified segmentation
certified source and relevant feature identities
decisions_required: Specify SNR definition, lookback, availability and bucket boundaries
Specify overnight and premarket windows in ET including DST
Select segmentation cutoffs and missing-data policy before inspecting results
Define minimum observations and no-trade reporting

experiments.name: Opening gap and day-type segmentation
experiments.objective: Measure outcome variation by opening gap and causally observable opening state, not end-of-day labels.
experiments.design: Construct gap metrics using finalized prior close and available opening prints, with explicit no-look-ahead boundaries.
dependencies: EXP-035–036 classifier design or independently approved as-of protocol
decisions_required: Select official prior close vs settlement and exact session calendar
Define gap direction/magnitude and as-of availability
Specify bucket thresholds and nontrading days
Specify sample-size and sensitivity reporting

experiments.name: Setup family by causal regime
experiments.objective: Examine reversal versus continuation performance conditioned on valid pre-entry regime labels.
experiments.control: PENDING: locked comparable control and candidate ledgers
experiments.candidate: NONE: interaction report; not a trading filter
experiments.design: Cross-tab family, regime, direction and year with sparse-cell safeguards; optional news omitted unless deterministic licensed event feed exists.
dependencies: certified data and adequate accepted-path coverage
frozen setup-family labels and trade outcomes
decisions_required: Preregister regime combinations and multiple-comparison handling
Set cell sample minimum and uncertainty presentation
Define whether news input is excluded or separately specified
Specify interpretation without post-hoc filtering

experiments.name: Year and month robustness
experiments.objective: Determine whether candidate performance is concentrated in one year or a small number of months.
experiments.control: PENDING: frozen comparable control and candidate with accepted trades
experiments.design: Compare per-year and per-month expectancy, profit factor, drawdown and trade counts with explicit insufficient-data states.
decisions_required: Approve candidate identity and valid comparable data years
Specify minimum per-period sample sizes and confidence intervals
Define missing-month handling and drawdown aggregation
Specify evaluation thresholds before results

experiments.name: Direction and setup-family robustness
experiments.objective: Detect whether aggregate results conceal weak long/short or reversal/continuation subgroups.
experiments.control: PENDING: immutable control and candidate trade ledgers
experiments.design: Disaggregate outcome and sample sizes across long/short and reversal/continuation with equivalent execution assumptions.
dependencies: EXP-039 frozen ledger or same approved independent ledger
decisions_required: Approve underlying candidates and common execution/cost identity
Define sample-size and uncertainty thresholds
Specify handling of mixed, missing or ambiguous family tags
Preregister criteria for unacceptable subgroup degradation
